items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I've worked with Johnny Sincere on bass too.

ctx.x: I think it was Kaliop and Franklin, well that's the first job I ever played on bass. And then I like bass. Now I've played the most, I've worked with Johnny Sincere on bass too. You know a couple of little parties like that? He came down and I was delivering, I mean I was delivering, I was running cab then. I worked with Johnny and Tats, you know Adolph Alexander? Oh yes, yeah. Well I flew around with them and worked on bass then. I didn't do too much on bass because I was really busy mostly on my horn most of…

Yeah. I was going to ask some more about those dances, say at Franz and Me, which was sort of one of the society places I understand. Yes. And what type of music did they play? Would they have played much Dixieland there or did they play mostly like quadrilles or waltzes?
